overloadPatches.semanticRole: Sets aTable (or the default table if omitted) to read/write state for the calling process; subsequently loaded records become unlocked (if not already locked by another user).
Sets every table to read/write state for the calling process, using the '*' form instead of naming a single table.

constraints: Only affects subsequently loaded records; it does not change the lock status of the record already loaded as current.
Read/write is the default state for all tables; this command is needed to revert a table from a prior READ ONLY call.
